name: leaven-public-seam-v1
key_decisions: Reflection and proposal are structurally separate (ReflectionResultV1 + ProposeRequestV1).
Leaven worker profile is the worker transport; Leaven seam methods carry all callbacks; no MCP layer in v1.

Host->worker stage dispatch rides one generic leaven/stage.run method bound to leaven.stage_run.v1 (request: stage kind + role-scoped stage payload; result: the stage output); worker callbacks stay on the Plan IR effect methods.
Watch deferred to v1.1; finite diff queries via consistency.since_revision.
Capability tokens: jti, subject fingerprint, binding, revocation, renewal, expiry behavior, aggregate budgets.
Data-class propagation: monotonic by default; deny overrides allow.
Plan results: typed values, typed receipts, started_at/completed_at, closed PlanError enum.
Workspace handles, release calls, git_status, sandbox streaming policy, ChangeFromAgentSession all first-class.
LM API: text + tools + tool_call_id + sampling + provider_hints + final_message + json_schema (multimodal/streaming deferred).
